text:
The Vantry maglev prototype reached a top speed of 540 km/h during its final acceleration trial at the Orrin Flats test corridor on 14 March 2031, according to the Vantry Transit Authority.

The train held that speed for 38 seconds over a 21 km stretch of the 48 km guideway. The figure appears in Trial Report VTA-MX-17, which the authority released after independent verification of both the onboard and trackside speed logs.

Dr. Selwyn Marachek, chief test engineer at the authority, oversaw the run and confirmed the reading.

"The onboard and trackside logs agree, and the prototype held 540 km/h for the full 38 seconds," Dr. Marachek said. "That is the number we are reporting, and it has been checked independently."

The trial was the last in the series of acceleration tests carried out at Orrin Flats. The full report is available from the Vantry Transit Authority.
